title: Custom Slash Commands

body.text: Create your own shortcut commands with
— e.g. a review.md file becomes the /review command, can use $ARGUMENTS to take user input, and the team shares it via git.

example: ".claude/commands/review.md: 'Review the code in $ARGUMENTS for bugs, security, and performance' → use: /review src/auth"

title: Commands a team should have

body.text: The most used in real teams:
/review (code review) · /test (write tests to team standards) · /pr (prepare commit + PR description)
— turn frequently repeated workflows into a command once, and everyone on the team uses the same standard.

example: "/pr → check the git diff, write a commit message to the team's convention, create a full PR description from the template"
